description: Level 2 increment 3: boss mechanics (grey-box) - test results

crews.change: 4 reserve crews (16 members) added along the Level 2 route, inactive in Level 1; encounters draw only from free crew members, never from peaceful people

bossFights.method: ?dev&level=2&stage=2|4&seed=N, bot with normal controls only (strike, shield, dodge); it reacts to visible state and does not know whether a wind-up is a feint
bossFights.bystandersInArena: 0 (after adding a 0.3 m boundary margin; before it, people on the edge measured 14.95-14.99 m from centre against a 15 m radius)

phaseTransitions.method: per threshold (10 and 5) x 10: bring the Leader to threshold+1, start an attack wind-up, land the crossing hit at varying points, then 3 more hits at once
phaseTransitions.observed: crossing hit always mid wind-up (chop, shove, swing); health clamped at the threshold; attack cancelled; all extra hits blocked; 0 attacks resolved and 0 player health lost during the transition; exactly one phase gained; boss back to idle

feints.method: phase 3 with feint chance forced to 1, 400 bot ticks
feints.realAttackAfterFeintDodged: 6/6 (bot spent a dodge on each feint, dodged again, invulnerable at the real chop)

chargeReactionWindow.method: officer standing still at distance D, charge launched; time from launch to contact (wind-up 1.0 s on top)
chargeReactionWindow.rule: regular charges trigger beyond 6.5 m; the back-off before a pattern charge now reaches 6.2 m (about 0.7 s)

chargeWallStun: obstacle between Enforcer and officer: wind -> charge -> stun (2.4 s), officer untouched, logged as wall impact; a frontal hit landed during the stun (10 -> 9). Not produced naturally in the bot runs, where every charge was dodged and ended by distance.

checkpoints.enforcer: died at 6/10 hp -> RETRY SECTION -> new fight, 10/10, phase 1, intro, arena on, score restored to section start (777), no axe
checkpoints.leader: died at 8/15 hp in phase 2 -> RETRY SECTION -> new fight, 15/15, phase 1, intro, arena on, score restored (777), exactly one axe

level2Determinism.secondLoad: identical time, score, health, stats, crowd positions and shortfall with different slice sizes and gaps (section timestamps differ only by harness sampling)

level2_30seeds.carriedFlags: too rare to assess (the eligible pool is crew members only, who carry no flags)

performance.note: built-in browser; GPU shared with other sessions' pages, so render times are noisy

mobileEmulation_375x812_touch.caveat: Chromium emulation on a desktop GPU; real phone performance not measured
